learning_outcomes.text: Calculates combined stresses and stress transformations.
Calculates deflection in beams for various loading conditions.

syllabus_topics: Simple Bending (Cont.): Eccentric Axial Loading in a Plane of Symmetry, Asymmetric Bending (Symmetric Section)
Simple Bending (Cont.): General Case of Eccentric Axial Loading
Stress and Strain Transformations: Stress Transformations, Plane Stress: Principal Stresses and Maximum Shear Stress
Stress and Strain Transformations (Cont.): Mohr's Circle for Plane Stress: Principal Stresses and Maximum Shear Stress

Stress and Strain Transformations (Cont.): General Stress State (3D), Yield Criterion for Ductile Materials and Fracture Criterion for Brittle Materials in Plane Stress, Stresses in Thin-Walled Pressure Vessels
Principal Stresses from a Loading: Principal Stresses in a Beam, Design of Transmission Shafts, Stresses in Combined Loadings
Principal Stresses from a Loading (Cont.): Stresses in Combined Loadings Applications, Moment of Inertia Calculations, Shear Force and Bending Moment Diagrams Review

Beam Deflection: Deformation of a Beam Subjected to Transverse Loading, Elastic Curve Equation and Determination of Beam Deflection by Integration, Direct Determination of Elastic Curve from Load Distribution
Beam Deflection (Cont.): Statically Indeterminate Beams, Determination of Beam Deflection Using Singularity Functions, Superposition Method and its Application
Beam Deflection (Cont.): Determination of Beam Deflection Using Singularity Functions
Determination of Beam Deflection Using Moment Area Method (Briefly), Columns: Stability of Structures, Euler's Formula for Pin-Ended Columns and Generalization to Other Cases & Applications
Energy Methods: Strain Energy, Strain Energy and Density, Elastic Strain Energy for Normal Stresses, Elastic Strain Energy for Shear Stresses

assessment_methods.method: Midterm Grade Contribution to Overall Success

assessment_rules: The midterm exam contributes 100% to the semester work grade. The final grade is calculated as 50% from the semester work (midterm) and 50% from the final exam.
bibliography: Cisimlerin Mukavemeti, Ferdinand P. Beer ve Russell Johnston, 2014 Literatür Yayınları
